reviews.title: App keeps crashing since latest update.
reviews.contents:
Sorry but I can’t see where I can report a bug. Since the last update the app just crashes randomly as I’m using it.

Edit: I had to delete the app and re-install it. Thanks for responding. Bumping the rating.

reviews.title: Activities not great, customer service very poor
reviews.contents:
I really liked the concept of this app so I downloaded it and paid for a yearly subscription. However, I found the activities are not challenging enough for my son. 
My son is meeting all of his milestones a little bit early or on time, so he is not super advanced or anything. Nonetheless, the app asks you to confirm list after list of which milestones they have reached and I have wasted so much time doing this, only to be recommended ideas that are boring for him/not engaging because the difficulty level is so low. My son is 14 months old and I still get recommended activities like “Sitting - to help your baby reach the sitting positions” when he is so beyond that. He is running! And I have updated that in the milestones page too!
I contacted Kinedu and they didn’t assist me by providing more challenging activities/suggestions and refused to refund me even a partial amount of the subscription cost that I paid. Since I have paid for it, I have logged back in from time to time over the past couple of months and updated the milestones pages, but the activities are just not good.
Furthermore, I found that most of the activities require some kind of set up which makes the app not practical to just whip out on a rainy day with your child and start an activity straight away. You have to watch the videos for the activity and since we don’t do screens with our son, I found it hard to watch them with him around.
I could be wrong but I think this app is designed for younger babies, maybe 0-6 months old. However, that’s the stage where they get fascinated by lying under a tree looking at the leaves and a kitchen utensil like a spatula is the best thing they’ve ever seen, so I personally wouldn’t pay for the subscription then either.

reviews.title: Fraudsters
reviews.contents: I subscribed for a free trial on this app on 20 Dec for 7 days through apple subscription. My subscription was expiring on 27-Dec and these guys charged my credit card outside apple wallet as they received on 26-Dec before even the free trial expired despite I had already cancelled my subscription few days earlier. I sent them email and they confirmed a refund is processed and will be done in 48hrs - it’s 9 days since and I have spent chasing them, apple store, my bank to get my refund. Don’t share your financial information with these guys even through apple subscription; since this doesn’t show in apple purchase so they won’t refund, Kinedu used my credit card outside apple wallet and now I have been wasting time chasing it. Your financial information is not safe as they are either fraudsters, or their support is rubbish or someone can easily hack and steal your data from them.

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.contents:
I love this app because I can see where my baby is developmentally and I can then teach my baby the appropriate traits and skills. You can also adjust the lessons if they are to easy or too hard so that you can do activities that are just right. 
I’ve noticed my baby can be advanced in some areas and lacking in others so I skip ahead to hard lessons or I go back to an easier one to help develop into the skill that may be lacking. 
Over all I love this app, gives me a guide to what to do with my baby, cause sometimes we as moms can get lost as to what to do and what stage our baby is and what they do at that stage.

reviews.title: $109 a year?!?
reviews.contents:
Yet another great app to come up on my suggested list and want such a huge amount of money per year. A free trial for a few days isn’t worth the risk of giving out my account details before the trial starts, that I’m sure I’ll forget about and have $109 taken out and no doubt have a lot of trouble getting back. You’d be better off not having it advertised as a free app when people in this cost of living crisis need to sell a limb to pay for it.
Such a great concept of an app but again, huge costs are a no. The target audience is definitely new parents but who has the money to buy something like this when you’re a new parent?

reviews.title: Sneaky and terrible service
reviews.contents: These guys prey on and take advantage of parents, engaging in practices that ACCC has actively pursued other foreign companies for including deceptive practices and subscription traps. Don’t miss a renewal, even if you contact them within 1 day of the renewal that they absolutely will not tell you or give you any advance warning that it is coming (something that the ACCC has taken issue with many times with other companies), they won’t refund it even though there is no way you will use their service at all once your child is too old. I can’t recommend avoiding this company more!!!

reviews.title: Wonderful help
reviews.contents:
Kinedu helped me keeping track of his sleeps, which helped wonderful in predicting his naps so my baby doesn’t get fussy.
It also has a great library with tips and exercises and play suggestions on what to do with your baby. 
Would recommend to any new anxious parent that wants to be prepared or just needs a little help with tracking or activities.

reviews.title: Taking money out!
reviews.contents: Why are you taking money out of my account? I can’t seem to see a subscription in my sub subscription area in my App Store! I only used this app for two days to try it out and I’ve been charged again! You say to cancel via App Store but there is no subscription there! When I went to cancel subscription on app after digging and digging to find it you locked me out of my account and every time I try change password you tell me you sent an email and you didn’t! You’re a very deceiving app

reviews.title: I suggest some little Improvement
reviews.contents:
They could go a little more into details with the activities and not to repeat them so much. 
They should also send you weekly articles about your child development and what to expect. Apart from that, the app is really useful and gives you nice ideas

reviews.title: Baby’s age is out
reviews.contents: Had high expectations for this app but upon signing up, first it got stuck on the page where you enter your details. After reloading multiple times it finally loaded. Then I noticed that my baby’s age is a month out. The date of birth is correct. But it says she is one month old when she is actually two. So all developmental milestones are out by a month making the app useless for me.
